title: Preservation of Civil Rights Protections Act of 2002
short_title: Preservation of Civil Rights Protections Act of 2002

committees.name: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.

summaries.text: Preservation of Civil Rights Protections Act of 2002 - Amends the Federal Arbitration Act to exclude all employment contracts from arbitration provisions (current law excludes employment contracts of seamen, railroad employees, or any other class of workers engaged in foreign or interstate commerce).Makes clauses in employment contracts that require arbitration of a dispute arising under the Constitution or U.S. laws unenforceable, with exceptions: (1) where the parties knowingly and voluntarily consent to submit a dispute to arbitration after the dispute arises; and (2) with regard to an employee or union enforcing any rights or terms of a valid collective bargaining agreement.
